bio.text: Robert Dickey represents District 134 in the Georgia House of Representatives and was first elected in 2011.
According to his legislative biography, Dickey is a fourth-generation peach and timber grower who owns Dickey Farms, Inc. with his wife and son, and is a past president of the Georgia Peach Council.
The biography says he was elected to the Flint Energies Board of Directors in 1994 and served as its vice chair until he was elected to the House.
It says he received a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Georgia and an MBA from Georgia College and State University.
